Maria G.: Heads up — planning to push engine v4.2 + q8a-fast quant profile to canary tonight ~22:00 PT. Quick sync: who can own the smoke window and rollback if things go sideways?
Sam K.: I can watch the 22:00-23:30 window. I'll be oncall. Ping me in this thread right before deploy.
Jess P.: I'll run the smoke checklist and do the perf dashboards check. Do we have the exact canary routing policy?
Arun R.: Canary will be 5% traffic in us-west-2, routed to pool:eng-v4-canary. Policy: gradual 1% increments over 5 mins, stop on gating fail.
Maria G.: Thanks. Gating thresholds we agreed in PR: p95 latency increase <= +12ms, error_rate delta <= +0.03% absolute, model-rr (rerank drift) < 0.5 points on our eval set.
Sam K.: Can you paste the commands I should run for smoke? I want a compact checklist I can copy.
Jess P.: Sure — I'll drop the minimal runbook here:

```
# quick smoke (30s window)
redwoodctl check health --cluster eng-v4-canary
curl -sS https://canary.us-west-2.api.redwood.ai/health | jq .status
# small inference sample
curl -X POST https://canary.us-west-2.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"Hello, world","max_tokens":8}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY'
# perf metrics (last 5m)
metrix query "p95_latency{pool=\"eng-v4-canary\"}" --range 5m
```

Lucy (deploy-bot): Deploy plan scheduled by Maria G. at 1768008000. Canary policy attached: canary_policy_2026-03.json.
Henry T.: On rollback: use the LP image tag we kept: `engine-v4.1-stable-202603`. Command: `redwoodctl rollout set --pool eng-v4-canary --image engine-v4.1-stable-202603` and then `redwoodctl rollout promote --pool eng-v4 --source eng-v4-canary` if we need to stop the global rollout.
Maria G.: Good. Also note the quant profile tweak: q8a-fast disables per-layer outlier correction; if you see token quality regressions, revert to q8a-safety.
Sam K.: I'll monitor: traces, p95, 5xx, and model-quality alert (rerank drift). If any of these breach, I call abort and trigger rollback.
Jess P.: What dashboard panels should I snapshot for the post-mortem if things go wrong?
Arun R.: Snapshot: p50/p95/p99, tail latency heatmap, 5xx rate, token throughput, and the eval-run outputs for the prompt set `canary_smoke_v4`. Also save a copy of the requests that got degraded.
Sam K.: Noted. I'll tag @eng-sre if we hit >0.1% user-facing errors.
Maria G.: Final ask: please review the small CR I pushed to add a preflight L7 check — it runs a syntactic validation against the quantized kernels. Link: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/eng-runtime/-/merge_requests/412
Jess P.: Reviewed and left 2 minor comments. Nothing blocking for tonight.
Henry T.: I'll be reachable on pager if needed. Also leaving a short curl-based rollback helper in case CLI is flaky:

```
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/eng-v4-canary engine=registry.redwood.ai/engine-v4.1-stable-202603

```
